reviews.title: It just works, Despite Some Trouble with Install
reviews.comment: I bought this for a family member's first DIY build. I have built many PCs but they had trouble with installing it as the first time. I will however say that they live in the hot desert of Arizona and have never had issues with temps. This thing is a beast for the price and you won't be disappointed. It looks great in an all-white build too. When I say desert, I mean deep desert, with virtually minimal shelter and no AC. I had my doubts but haven't had any issues yet.

reviews.title: Excellent Cooling, Tedious Set-Up
reviews.comment: I'm a long time user of CoolerMaster CPU coolers, and generally I've been happy with them; this unit is no exception. For a Ryzen 5800X CPU, I get consistent idle temps of 35°C and stress temps of 55°C which is 10°-15° below the previous cooler I was using, so I'm quite happy with its performance. I'm not very interested in RGB, but the look is quite nice as well. That said, know that most CoolerMaster coolers are tedious to set the fans up for; the 622 addresses some of these issues but introduces others in the process. These fans have a small metal latch you can push out (as opposed to pulling in older models) from the heatsink, but there are no clearly indicated areas on the heatsink where you should place them. The only way to know for sure that both fans are at the same height on each side is to count how many layers are between the latch and one end of the heatsink. It's not a deal breaker for the overall quality, but it is tedious. Also, if you are using an AM4 socket, make sure you have the stock backplate or a replacement; since you can't change the backplate on AM5 sockets, the 622 does not come with a backplate for AM4 sockets.

reviews.title: big, bulky, but works wonders!!!!
reviews.comment: Not gonna lie, I thought this Dual-Fan CPU Air Cooler wasn't going to fit my PC case at first (got an older Zalman Z11-Plus case), but not only does it fit, but the rainbow-colored lights looks pretty good and it keeps my CPU running cool.  I will admit, that it was a little bit frustrating trying to put the screws in place, but it worked!!!!
